en.name: King
en.ability: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.

zh.name: 国王
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，如果死亡的玩家数量大于或等于存活的玩家数量，你会得知一个存活的角色。恶魔知道你是国王。
